meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频镜头加上推拉缩放与镜头运动动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让视频片段有缩放、推拉或镜头运动等动画效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, and camera-move keyframes to video shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're animating zooms, punch-ins, or camera moves inside video shots.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成写 seek-safe 的 2D/3D 关键帧动画,如推拉镜头、缩放、Ken Burns、遮罩等,覆盖 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js、WAAPI,并用 hyperframes lint、check、keyframes 做诊断与截图验证。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推拉镜头、缩放、Ken Burns 等关键帧动画时接管;广泛场景策略、品牌设计、字幕、素材采购不在其范围。

say.text: 给这个合成加一个 punch-in 推拉镜头,主体是产品图。
say.note: 用 seek-safe 关键帧实现并跑诊断。

say.text: 把主体写成多段缩放的状态阶梯,输出各证明点的截图。
say.note: 生成关键帧并给出证明快照。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames compositions (punch-ins, zooms, Ken Burns, masks, etc.) across GSAP, CSS, Anime.js and WAAPI, then verifies pixels with hyperframes lint, check and keyframes.
howto.when_en: It takes over when a HyperFrames composition needs keyframed motion such as punch-ins, zooms or Ken Burns camera moves; broad scene strategy, brand design, captions and media sourcing are out of scope.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in to this composition, with the product shot as the subject.
say_en.note: Implemented as seek-safe keyframes and diagnosed.

say_en.text: Build the subject as a multi-state zoom ladder and output snapshots at each proof pose.
say_en.note: Authors the keyframes and returns proof snapshots.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes on this selector and produce a --shot.
say_en.note: Returns the keyframe diagnostics and shot.
